items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: And then later on, Frank Christian was in New York. He wrote me. He wanted me to join him.

ctx.x: Red was in everything in music, wasn't he?

We'd get together and, no, we'd have a lot of fun, Emmett and Charlie. Oh, Emmett too, huh? Uh-huh. And we'd get out there and play and have a lot of fun. We were all kids. Ed on the piano. Sometimes Frank would play piano with us. And, uh, we went on a convention. I don't remember what year it was, but we were kids with the Chalamual Grotto, Kansas City, Missouri. Oh, yeah. And we had Leon Smallow on trombone. Mm. And Ed on piano. Donald on the violin. Charlie Leach on drums. And myself on clarinet. We had a…
No, no clarinet of trumpet, huh?
